subject: One SPDE model handles two survey datasets?

messages.author: 17f8070912132195
messages.subject: One SPDE model handles two survey datasets?
parts:
Hi all, 


There are two surveys occurring in my area of interest. They overlap to a limited extent, but I want to incorporate them into a model to capture a random spatial effect over a larger area. The survey id will be incorporated as a covariate. 


Does it make sense to do it this way? I am worried about whether these data sets have different kappa and tau.


Thanks!

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] One SPDE model handles two survey datasets?
parts:
you can say that spde_1 and spde_2 are two realizations from the same
distribution, using argument 'replicate'
